title: LST/synth market & intrinsic prices are USD but labeled "SOL"
why: jitoSOL hero reads 'market 100.94 SOL' for a ~1.04-SOL asset (~100x off); the most authoritative number on the page, mislabeled. formatUsd() already exists in format.ts:280.

title: Status uptime bars are 89/90 days fabricated by a PRNG
why: A trust oracle painting a fake 90-day green uptime wall (status/page.tsx:90-101) is self-defeating; render only measured data, left-pad rest UNKNOWN.

title: 'Health · 7d' and hero 'drift floor (7d)' computed from 24h of data
why: page.tsx:103-111 fetches only 24h; 3 of 4 KPIs + drift floor mislabeled 7d. Trust dies the moment a user cross-checks against the chart's 7d range.

title: Class-specific drift band invisible where spread is shown (dashboard self-contradicts)
why: sUSD +2.24% green PEGGED above USDT +0.13% amber DRIFT with no band shown reads as a broken engine; thresholdsFor() exists client-side (policy.ts:77).

title: Compare 'Save as watchlist' writes to a key nothing reads — fake 'Saved' pill
why: compare/page.tsx:328 writes pegana:watchlists (zero readers) while store uses pegana.watchlist.v1; the green pill fakes success and discards the work.

title: Comparable-events cards draw a hardcoded fake recovery curve
why: comparable-events.tsx:139-144 is an identical polyline for every event under a 'recovery profile' subtitle; a fake chart on a trust product is worse than none.

title: /assets spread color contradicts its own state pip
why: assets/page.tsx:140-149 colors by raw abs(bps) independent of state; INF -1.20% renders amber next to a PEGGED pip. Reuse STATE_COLOR.

title: WS silent-open socket leaves dashboard 'live' and frozen with no signal
why: ws.ts:38-43 reconnects on close only; a half-open socket shows frozen green numbers — the worst-case for a live watchdog. Add a heartbeat-timeout.

title: Per-row history re-fetches every render (SWR key off raw Date.now())
why: sparkline-cell.tsx:25 raw Date.now() drifts the SWR key (proven in network-asset.txt 30 vs 84); render from inline series_24h for zero extra requests.

title: Surface delivery_health on Status — the signal added for this page
why: types.ts:79-89 delivery_health has zero UI usages; 'All systems operational' while alerts silently fail to send is a lie. stats already fetched — no backend work.

title: Lighten depeg/critical spread-text tokens to pass WCAG AA
why: st-depeg 3.97:1 / st-critical 3.43:1 as spread text fail AA; the lowest-contrast color sits on the most-urgent value. Add text-only tokens validated on surface-2.

title: Cmd-K command palette + inline filter box
why: No search anywhere; only path to an asset is scanning 21 rows. Table stakes for a monitoring console; radix-ui already a dep.

title: Roving-tabindex keyboard nav; decouple peek from hover-only
why: asset-table.tsx:109 onMouseEnter is the only selection driver; a keyboard/touch user can never drive the peek pane.

title: Rewrite onboarding step 04 to the real 3-pane shell
why: onboarding-modal.tsx:674-690 teaches Anchor/mosaic/Lite-Pro/seed/search that don't exist; teaching a dead UI erodes trust on first contact.

title: Wire Events feed to live WS (pip + new-row flash)
why: events/page.tsx:77 is a 30s poll with no WS; a transition takes up to 30s with no indicator on the page people leave open during a depeg.

title: Add magnitude to event rows (discount/spread + sparkline)
why: AlertRow has no price/discount; every cluster reads 'N alerts, worst <state>' so a -0.2% wobble and a -8% crash look identical. assetMap + EventSparkline already exist.

title: Make /assets a real screener OR redirect to dashboard
why: /assets is a flatter clone of the dashboard; either add sort/search/sparkline/safety col or redirect like /assets/[symbol] already does.

title: Sortable column headers on /assets + URL-encoded sort
why: assets/page.tsx:114-119 headers are static spans; alphabetical-by-class buries USDT's DRIFT mid-table. 'Show widest spreads now' is the #1 question.

title: Sparkline column from inline series_24h (zero fetches)
why: Every asset ships a 25-point series_24h; render via the Sparkline atom (as asset-card.tsx does) for no extra request. Do NOT reuse SparklineCell (per-symbol fetch).

title: Status calibration banner (verdicts provisional through 06-10)
why: In the calibration window with no on-page signal verdicts are provisional; also pre-empts the threshold-confusion.

title: Per-row peg-stability/jitter signal from series_24h dispersion
why: Depeg is preceded by rising volatility; series_24h already ships. xSOL swings while jitoSOL is flat, both PEGGED today. Turns Pegana into a leading indicator.

title: Computed 'Widest now' / 'Drifting' Compare presets
why: Only 3 static presets; reconcileBps already imported. A 'widest now' preset answers the question users came to a peg oracle to ask.

title: Compare share-link + PNG/CSV export
why: Selection is URL-driven but nothing surfaces it; export turns Compare into a workbench and a shared ?s= link is a live product demo.

title: Per-series PEGGED-band guides on the Compare overlay
why: Raw spread across classes is apples-to-oranges; a yield token's wide-band line reads as 'worse' without the band guide.

title: Quiet preview mode for empty-state ghost chart
why: compare/page.tsx:211 wraps a live chart in opacity-30 only; legend + axis ticks bleed through and read as a loading glitch on the marquee feature.

title: State-transition markers + shaded DRIFT/DEPEG regions on chart
why: The classification (the product's core output) is invisible on its own chart; per-point state color already computed. Use lightweight-charts v5 createSeriesMarkers.

title: Market-vs-intrinsic two-line chart view
why: The chart never shows the two prices it's the spread of; 'two prices drifting apart' is the core mental model. History rows lack per-row prices so reconstruct or extend API.

title: Share/permalink + URL-encoded tab/range/mode (+ OG image)
why: A peg event is viral and the asset page is the artifact; today there's no deep-linkable state or share button, so every share lands on a default view.

title: Recovery-confidence rubric breakdown + HelpIcon + 'calibrating' badge
why: A black-box 'C · 63%' with invisible weights and no methodology link is the most dangerous element on a trust product. HelpIcon exists elsewhere.

title: Exit liquidity: fetch on mobile (stacked cards) instead of blanking
why: exit-liquidity.tsx:85-88 blanks every viewport <=1023px while the footnote still claims live quotes; guts the most differentiated feature where retail lives.

title: Fix hardcoded '24h spread' H2 (range toggle goes to 30d)
why: page.tsx:205-207 asserts a window the chart control can change; fires on first paint for any returning user whose persisted range isn't 24h.

title: Sign-convention label ('premium'/'discount' to NAV) at hero + list
why: Bare signed % with no direction word; users mis-read a benign LST premium as a problem. glossary-sheet.tsx:23 already defines the terms.

title: fetch timeout (AbortSignal) so a hung API fails fast
why: client.ts:23-37 has no signal; a half-open hang leaves SWR in perpetual skeleton. jupiter-quote already uses the pattern.

title: aria-live + announce on dashboard state pips
why: asset-table.tsx:124-133 is a bare aria-hidden pip with no live region; a PEGGED->DEPEG flip is announced to nobody. /assets already does it right.

title: Subscribe asset-detail hero/chart to live WS; patch market/intrinsic into overrides
why: Dashboard already reconciles state+discount, but the deep-linked asset page uses plain SWR (60s poll) and $-values aren't patched — it lags during the moment that matters.

title: Deep-link Events to the depeg moment (?t= + chart scroll/marker)
why: Header promises 'replayable' but the row link lands on the default view; the cluster already knows the exact timestamps.

title: Promote sort headers + density toggle + band-% column
why: Sort works but the controls are 9px mono glyphs with direction arrow only on spread; the power exists but is invisible.

title: Mark pinned rows in table; one-tap row pin; server-side watchlist
why: Watchlist is localStorage-only, unmarked in the densest pane, and never syncs despite auth; it's the retention hook for a monitoring tool.

title: Default peek to worst-state asset, not widest |spread|
why: page.tsx:103-109 auto-previews sUSD +2.24% PEGGED while the only DRIFT (USDT) is elsewhere; the auto-preview should agree with the alarm coloring.

title: Render peek from lg so the reserved 360px column isn't a dead gutter
why: grid is lg:grid but peek is xl:flex, so 1024-1279px reserves a 360px column that renders nothing.

title: Visible live heartbeat (pulse dot + 'updated Ns ago')
why: One GSAP flash + static SVG + hardcoded 'Tick 1.2s' make the dashboard read as a snapshot; the felt 'this is live' quality justifies the real-time claim.

title: App entrance choreography (reuse GSAP Reveal) + <MotionConfig reducedMotion>
why: App has zero entrance motion the marketing site has, and no MotionConfig — a real a11y hole since the CSS guard doesn't stop framer JS.

title: Sharp-geometry sweep: rounded-none on onboarding modal; delete 01-06 numbers
why: brand.md:78 locks 0px radius and v3 deleted section numbers; the modal reads as a generic shadcn dialog. 15 rounded usages in that file alone.

title: Route tick-flash through a token; fix #feed7a/#ff8400 hex leaks
why: Raw iridescent #ff8400 fires on every WS tick (decoration not ammunition) and #feed7a is a literal keyword color; brand.md:176 bans hardcoded hex.

title: Gate the onboarding shimmer loop with reduced-motion
why: onboarding-modal.tsx:726-735 loops repeat:Infinity unlike its siblings; animates 'left' so MotionConfig won't cover it — needs manual gating.

title: Reframe 'Bloomberg-density' comments; flat sub-bar (no wash-gradient section bg)
why: Code comments reintroduce the banned framing and the engine sub-bar paints a forbidden full-section wash gradient; near-mechanical fixes, rendered UI is on-brand.

title: Mono -> sans on interactive English labels/CTAs
why: Mono on 'Compare'/'Open asset page'/filter words is the quiet path back to the terminal aesthetic brand.md:17 bans; keep mono for numbers/tickers.

title: Drive shell height off measured header, not two hardcoded literals
why: page.tsx:189 subtracts 60+50px that don't map to elements; panes stop short of the viewport and jump when banners mount.

title: List -> Compare deeplink (multi-select / 'Compare top 4 LSTs')
why: assets/page.tsx:104-110 is a bare /compare link with no preselection; the deeplink pattern is already proven at peer-comparison.tsx:77.

title: Shared-layout (layoutId) row->detail transition + animated live re-sort
why: No layoutId anywhere; navigation is a hard swap and rows teleport on re-sort. Cheap on-brand polish that makes live state legible.

title: Compare drag-to-zoom + brush/minimap
why: Synced crosshair read-out already exists; what's missing is zoom-into-divergence, the depth power-users expect from TradingView/Curve.

title: Exit-liquidity depth curve (8-10 log-spaced sizes + 'safe exit size')
why: Three fixed sizes hide where slippage knees; a curve answers 'how much can I get out before it moves?' on real routing data no TVL competitor has.

title: Intrinsic/NAV backing decomposition (Proof-of-Reserves)
why: intrinsic_usd is opaque; decomposing it (SOL/share, collateral vs short, reserve mix) moves Pegana from gap-meter to why-is-this-worth-its-claim and is a visible trust companion that works today.

title: Seed Events with historical reference depegs (USDC Mar-2023) as replay cards
why: The flagship 'Every depeg, replayable' shows an empty grid during calibration; replaying public incidents is the conversion demo and works before Pegana has its own history.

title: PPR/cache-components streaming shell for asset detail
why: asset/[symbol]/page.tsx is fully client-rendered; a static shell + streamed live holes would sub-second the most-shared surface, but needs a server-component split.

title: Make Status uptime bars interactive once real data lands
why: UptimeBars supports onDayClick but Status never passes it; bars render as inert aria-hidden spans. Ship with the real-data fix.

title: Reframe calm-market Events empty state as 'all clear'
why: Zero events is good news for a depeg tracker but renders as a barren null; the backend-down branch is already built, this is only the calm-vs-filtered distinction.
